title: Annotatio IV §.III open: Further rivulets from either Obex fountain — noted by our Author
pass_a_gloss: §. III. From either Fountain of the Obstacles other and still other Rivulets, drawing like water, are led down, noted by our Author.
pass_b_english: §. III. From either fountain of these obstacles still other rivulets run down, drawing the same kind of water — ones our Author notes.
source_text:
§. III.
Ex utroque Obicum Fonte alii aliique Rivuli, consimilem aquam trahentes, deducuntur, Autori nostro notati.
notes: §.III open; further rivulets from both Obex fountains.
